scope: Bridge actual bounded Body Dependency and UpdateNotice records to existing source/claim-DAG and predecessor-DAG algorithms, then informational reverse impact and complete labeled paths. No full ReplayResult, Task/Manifest/Reading/externalReplayRequest/runtime closure, authority/current source selection, authentication, truth or completeness.
entrypoint: check_declared_impact(body_raw:object,originals:object,held_update_pins:object)->own bounded dict. First preserve complete frozen claim/source/body validation and output caps through a private owned validated-claim bundle; no caller decoded Body/bundle/bool/schema bypass and no additional source loader IO.

held_update_pins.type: exact builtin tuple, at most8 items; each exact builtin tuple(event_id:str,sha256:str,byte_length:int)
held_update_pins.bounds: Outer/item type and counts before traversal; event_id exactstr ASCII<=32 with pinned Id pattern-search semantics, SHA exactstr64 lowercasehex, byte_length exactint0..65536 neverbool. All fields immutable; snapshot before hashing/equality. No iterable/provider/path/custom key or candidate-derived missing pin.
held_update_pins.set: Unique event IDs; exact set of all supplied Body.updates IDs, no missing/extra/duplicate pin. Compare every pin to complete canonical UpdateNotice bytes, never exclude a field. Independently held custody is an assumption supplied separately, not established by matching; result independent_custody=UNKNOWN, update_authentication=UNVERIFIED, current_authority=NONE.

history_boundary: This smallest component admits only Body.history=[]; any nonempty history refuses IMPACT_HISTORY_UNSUPPORTED. It does not report already-recorded or retained-history success. Originals/history artifacts remain untouched. Exact historical UpdateNotice-byte comparison and full history replay remain required before that feature/full replay claim.

caps.inherited: All frozen raw/source/claim/body/source-count/physical-byte/depth/work/output caps remain. Distinct SourceVersion aliases remain physically charged; only complete identical SourceKeys are one graph source node. No cap increase, truncation, fetch, mutation or hidden identity substitution.

stage_order.rule: Entire frozen claim/source/input pipeline including both public-output bounds first; propagate exact existing refusals unchanged. Private validated-claim bundle may expose only owned parsed Body, verified originals, checked claim result and already pinned schema to this stage.

Outer tuple then length<=8 before item traversal; malformed container/item/scalar type IMPACT_PIN_TYPE; bounded scalar shape/range IMPACT_PIN_SHAPE. Do not hash/sort unbounded host values. Preserve pinned Id finalLF semantics, no stronger fullmatch.

Update IDs unique (IMPACT_UPDATE_DUPLICATE), held IDs unique (IMPACT_PIN_DUPLICATE), exact event ID set (IMPACT_PIN_SET), complete canonical digest/length match in lexical Update ID order (IMPACT_UPDATE_PIN). All notices, including roots/unreachable ones, must match separately supplied pins before graph work.
Body.history nonempty=>IMPACT_HISTORY_UNSUPPORTED; do not ignore, delete or pretend prior history was checked.

For every actual Dependency in lexical ID order, require exact dependent ClaimLabel exists (IMPACT_DEPENDENT_MISSING), and exactly that Claim lists its dependency ID once, with no other owner (IMPACT_DEPENDENCY_UNOWNED). Earlier claim gate already enforces duplicate Claim/Dependency IDs and referenced owners. For SOURCE target require identical complete SourceKey among verified sources (IMPACT_SOURCE_TARGET_MISSING). For CLAIM target require supplied exact Claim id/revision (IMPACT_CLAIM_TARGET_MISSING) then exact recomputed canonical ClaimKey digest/length (IMPACT_CLAIM_TARGET_PIN). No label/version-only substitution, inferred edge or ignored unused record.

Nodes are unique complete SourceKeys plus unique complete ClaimKeys; sources terminal, every Dependency directed dependentClaim->requiredSource/Claim. Enforce32nodes/64labelededges before traversal (IMPACT_GRAPH_BOUND). Existing reverse_reachable validates all components with empty seed set; cycle=>IMPACT_DEPENDENCY_CYCLE, other unexpected graph refusal=>IMPACT_GRAPH_REJECTED. The helper's unlabeled endpoint adjacency is explicitly deduplicated because parallel labeled Dependency IDs are preserved separately and still consume64edge budget. Parallel IDs remain distinct paths; never deduplicate them from evidence.

In lexical Update ID order require old_version logical ID equals notice logical_source_id and exact old SourceKey exists (IMPACT_UPDATE_LOGICAL / IMPACT_UPDATE_SOURCE_MISSING). REPLACEMENT requires nonnull distinct same-logical new_version and null correction_text. WITHDRAWAL requires null new_version and null correction_text. ATTRIBUTED_CORRECTION requires nonnull correction_text and either null new_version or distinct same-logical key. Kind/cross-field failure IMPACT_UPDATE_KIND; same-logical mismatch IMPACT_UPDATE_LOGICAL; missing exact nonnull new source IMPACT_UPDATE_SOURCE_MISSING. No timestamp or issuer label grants authority. Direct Update.provenance must pin a unique supplied canonical Provenance record (IMPACT_PROVENANCE_DUPLICATE / IMPACT_UPDATE_PROVENANCE_MISSING / IMPACT_UPDATE_PROVENANCE_PIN). Optional evidence must pin a supplied UPDATE_EVIDENCE Blob (IMPACT_UPDATE_EVIDENCE_MISSING / IMPACT_UPDATE_EVIDENCE_PIN / IMPACT_UPDATE_EVIDENCE_KIND). Run/provenance authentication and unrelated record closure remain unverified.

For every nonnull predecessor ID in lexical Update order require actual supplied UpdateNotice (IMPACT_PREDECESSOR_MISSING), necessarily already held-pin matched, and same logical_source_id (IMPACT_PREDECESSOR_LOGICAL). No missing-to-root coercion. Map lexical event IDs to existing predecessor_order; self/multi-cycle=>IMPACT_PREDECESSOR_CYCLE; other unexpected helper failure=>IMPACT_PREDECESSOR_REJECTED. All events checked. Predecessor means informational event precedence only, never version continuity, sequential validity or currentness.

Effect is exact(kind,new_version,correction_text), no prose equivalence. Distinct notices conflict iff effects differ and either complete old_version keys agree regardless of predecessors, or nonnull predecessor ID and logical source ID agree. Different IDs/provenance/issuer alone do not conflict for identical effects. Preserve all IDs, no winner selection. A Claim is CONFLICT if affected by any conflicting notice; review impact remains separate.

Every fully validated notice, including otherwise identical-effect duplicates with different IDs, seeds its exact old_version. Call existing bounded reverse_reachable per unique seed (or every bounded notice), retaining trigger-ID association. Claim with no declared path to any seed=>UNCHANGED_DECLARED_CLOSURE; otherwise NEEDS_REVALIDATION, never false. All trigger IDs reported sorted. Complete dependencies permit MATCH unless any trigger is conflicting; this MATCH is dependency/update context only, not full Task/applicability.

Before path enumeration for a seed, prune to nodes reverse-reachable from that seed. Traverse only labeled outgoing edges whose target is in that pruned set, so every visited prefix can extend to the seed; do not explore exponential dead ends. Iterative stack only, per-path<=32edges, all traversal/backtrack operations charged to fixed8192perClaim budget over every trigger (IMPACT_PATH_WORK_BOUND). Each distinct(trigger_update_id,ordered Dependency-ID vector) is an exact path record, counted toward64total perClaim across all triggers; discovering a65th=>IMPACT_PATH_LIMIT. Parallel edge IDs and repeated-seed trigger IDs remain separate. Never trim or serialize a success prefix.

All nonpath fields/trigger sets are known before enumeration. Canonical empty-path result skeleton plus reservedLF is charged first. Each one bounded canonical path record plus necessary comma is charged before appending, and scratch<=4096; overflow IMPACT_OUTPUT_BYTE_BOUND. Final canonical complete result+LF must equal tracked size and fit32768; mismatch is a defect, not permission to truncate. Sort paths lexically by Dependency-ID vectors then trigger ID, with arrays/sets sorted as below. Any later refusal discards all private intermediate indexes.

ordering: Claims by(id,revision), Update/Dependency IDs lexically, source graph nodes by canonical SourceKey bytes and claim nodes by canonical ClaimKey bytes within their fixed SOURCE then CLAIM partitions. Build helper edges from those deterministic indices. Output Claim entries lexical; trigger/conflict/update IDs lexical; each Claim paths sorted by(dependency_ids vector,trigger_update_id). Input array order grants no priority/currentness.

success_shape.updates: lexical closed entries {id,pin:{id,sha256,bytes},old_version,status:INFORMATIONAL_QUARANTINED}; pin matches separately supplied held tuple and complete actual canonical event
success_shape.claims: lexical closed entries {claim:complete canonical ClaimKey,declared_preconditions:MATCH|CONFLICT,change_impact:UNCHANGED_DECLARED_CLOSURE|NEEDS_REVALIDATION,trigger_update_ids,paths}. Each path closed {trigger_update_id,seed:complete old SourceKey,dependency_ids}. Claim identity supplied by containing entry, never omitted from binding.

refusal_shape.stage: exact first stage or unchanged inherited stage
refusal_shape.error: exact named code; no extra/null/partial-success fields

trust_boundary: Matching original/record/pin bytes is integrity under SHA256 assumptions, not author authentication, independently witnessed custody, source truth or authorization. Private Python graph results remain fallible informational data; consequential decisions stay behind applicable verified boundary. No state persistence, update application, revalidation clearing, external authority or full replay claim.
required_evidence: Owner adoption of exact contract/manual oracle/event-pin boundary, independent actual-GPT-6.1 review, then separately authorized implementation/component tests/resource controls. Existing full Task/Manifest/Reading/runtime/global provenance/recovery/interoperability/native proof/external-human/product gates remain binding.
